docs.title: dpdpkit
docs.text:
Open-source building blocks for India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025. dpdpkit provides a consent ledger, versioned notices, rights requests, retention with pre-erasure warnings, and audit evidence. It runs inside your own app, against your own database.

You use Install FastAPI pip install "dpdpkit[fastapi]" Django (v0.4) pip install "dpdpkit[django]" Node, PHP, Java, Go, .NET (v0.5) docker run ghcr.io/dpdpkit-dev/server React front end npm i @dpdpkit/react @dpdpkit/client

Most Data Fiduciary obligations become enforceable on 13 May 2027.

docs.title: Principles
docs.text:
• Primitives, not promises. dpdpkit gives you tools. It never claims to make you compliant.
  • Rules as data. Every legal number lives in a versioned policy pack.
  • Fail safe. If a warning is not delivered or a job fails, dpdpkit holds and alerts. It never deletes or files anything on its own.
  • Your data stays with you. Open-source installs never call home.

docs.title: Consent ledger
docs.text:
Consent events are appended to a SHA-256 hash chain per tenant. Every other state change (requests, schedules, holds) goes to a second, audit chain.

  • dpdpkit ledger verify recomputes both chains. It names the first row whose contents or chain link do not match (exit code 2).
  • dpdpkit ledger root prints the current heads. Export them periodically to storage you cannot rewrite, so truncating the tail of the chain is detectable too.

docs.title: Policy packs
docs.text:
Every legal number dpdpkit uses (the 48-hour pre-erasure warning, the one-year log floor, the 90-day grievance ceiling) lives in a versioned YAML pack in dpdpkit-policies. No such number is in code.

dpdpkit policy show
dpdpkit policy diff dpdp-rules-2025.v1 my-pack.yaml

A missing or invalid pack stops dpdpkit from starting. There are no built-in defaults. See Rule to code for every key and its legal source.

docs.title: Retention and erasure
docs.text:
1. Activity (login, contact) restarts each purpose's inactivity clock.
  2. retention.erasure_pre_notice_hours before erasure (48 in the base pack), dpdpkit sends a warning through your notifier.
  3. Erasure runs only after the warning is recorded as delivered, and only once the full warning period has passed since delivery.
  4. Any activity after the warning cancels the erasure.
  5. Failed delivery, missing contact details, a failing erasure handler or a legal hold all move the schedule to needs_attention. A person decides what happens next.
  6. Ledger and audit rows are never erased. They are kept for at least retention.min_log_retention_days.

docs.title: FastAPI quickstart
docs.text:
Work in progress

The full quickstart ("running in under 30 minutes") is task FAPI-14. Until then, see the dpdpkit-fastapi README and the examples/fastapi_shop app.

pip install "dpdpkit[fastapi]"
dpdpkit init
dpdpkit migrate --db-url "$DATABASE_URL"

docs.title: Any other stack
docs.text: dpdpkit-server runs the FastAPI adapter as a standalone container with its own database. Your backend calls its REST API, and your front end uses @dpdpkit/embed web components. The server ships in v0.5 (tasks SRV-01 to SRV-08).

docs.title: REST contract
docs.text: The contract is openapi.yaml in dpdpkit-spec. Every adapter and dpdpkit-server must pass the same conformance suite before release.

docs.title: Rule to code
docs.text:
Generated from dpdpkit-policies. Each row shows a pack key, its value, the legal source and the dpdpkit module that reads it.

Pack key Value in dpdp-rules-2025.v1 Legal source What it controls Code commencement.consent_manager 2026-11-13 DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 4 read with Rule 1(3) Consent Manager provisions start one year after publication. dpdpkit.policy commencement.fiduciary_duties 2027-05-13 DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 1(3); G.S.R. 843(E) Most Data Fiduciary duties and principal rights start eighteen months after publication. dpdpkit.policy notice.required_links ["withdraw", "rights", "board_complaint"] DPDP Act s.5, s.6(4); DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 3(c) A notice must link to withdrawing consent, exercising rights and complaining to the Board. dpdpkit.notices notice.languages ["en", "hi"] DPDP Act s.5(3) Principals may read the notice in English or any Eighth Schedule language. dpdpkit.notices consent.withdrawal_parity True DPDP Act s.6(4); DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 3(c)(i) Withdrawing consent must be as easy as giving it. dpdpkit.consent retention.erasure_pre_notice_hours 48 DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(2) Tell the principal at least 48 hours before erasure; any login or contact cancels it. dpdpkit.retention retention.min_log_retention_days 365 DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 6(1)(e) and Rule 8(3) Keep personal data, traffic data and processing logs for at least one year. dpdpkit.retention, dpdpkit.ledger retention.third_schedule {"ecommerce": {"min_users": 20000000, "inactivity_years": 3}, "online_gaming": {"min_users": 5000000, "inactivity_years": 3}, "social_media": {"min_users": 20000000, "inactivity_years": 3}} DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1), Third Schedule Large e-commerce, online gaming and social media fiduciaries erase after three years without the principal's approach. dpdpkit.retention rights.grievance_max_days 90 DPDP Act s.13; DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 14(3) Publish a grievance response period of no more than 90 days. dpdpkit.rights rights.request_max_days 90 DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 14; PIB explainer, 14 Nov 2025 Rights requests are treated as having the same 90-day ceiling. dpdpkit.rights rights.request_default_target_days 30 dpdpkit default (configurable), below the ceiling Target response time for rights requests, shown to the principal. dpdpkit.rights children.age_of_majority 18 DPDP Act s.2(f), s.9; DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 10 A child is anyone under 18; processing needs verifiable parental consent. dpdpkit.guardians breach.board_detailed_report_hours 72 DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 7(2)(b) Send the Board a detailed breach report within 72 hours of becoming aware. dpdpkit.incidents
